title: Firework Customizer
description: New GUI Helper For Your Fireworks
body:
**Firework Customizer**

Firework Customizer is a Minecraft mod that introduces an advanced system for customizing fireworks directly in-game. It allows players to fully control the appearance, behavior, and effects of fireworks through a clean and intuitive interface.

With this mod, you can modify colors, explosion shapes, flight duration, particle types, and special visual effects, creating unique and complex combinations that are not possible in vanilla Minecraft. Customization is applied in real time to the firework held in the player’s hand.

The mod also includes a cost system — modifying fireworks requires gold, adding balance and making the feature more meaningful in survival gameplay.

Firework Customizer is perfect for both regular gameplay and creating visual shows, server events, or decorative builds, taking fireworks to a whole new level.
